_comment: Issue #97 step 1: FB rising-edge times (1..8, td=40n) at the 4 TYP corners of request-diag-97.json, to read the divide ratio where tfb is unreached. Same body/start-up as request-stage2.json.

RESISTOR LOADING (issue #452): repaired in place -- this deck instantiates PDK rppd/rhigh resistors (PR #169) but carried no resistor model, so ngspice aborted at parse (unknown subckt rppd). Added cornerRES.lib (SLOW/TYP/FAST = res_wcs/res_typ/res_bcs) and the r3_cmc OSDI, as res_stage2() in make_requests.py does (issue #164). Regenerating this file from its make_* generator reintroduces the gap; re-run repair_res_loading.py afterwards.
